'''Mohammad Saleem''' (1934–2 January 2016) was a Pakistani [[Particle physics|particle physicist]] and a professor of physics at the [[University of the Punjab|Punjab University]]. He was the founding director of the [[Centre for High Energy Physics]], and author of mathematical physics book, ''Group Theory for High Energy Physicists'', published in 2016.

==Biography==

Saleem was born in 1934, and received in his [[Bachelor of Arts|BA]] with Honors in [[mathematics]], followed by [[Master of Arts|MA]] in mathematics, and [[Master of Science|MSc]] in physics from the [[University of the Punjab|University of Punjab]].<ref name="The Nation, 2016">{{cite news |title=Prof Saleem passes away |url=https://nation.com.pk/02-Jan-2016/prof-saleem-passes-away |accessdate=27 April 2020 |work=The Nation |agency=The Nation |publisher=The Nation |date=2 January 2016 |language=en}}</ref>{{rp|xi}}<ref name="Taylor & Francis, Saleem & Rafique, 2016"/> He was further educated in the United Kingdom where he received [[British undergraduate degree classification|BSc]] in [[First class honours]] in Physics.{{rp|xi}}<ref name="Taylor & Francis, Saleem & Rafique, 2016"/> Upon returning, he entered in doctoral program in his alma mater, and successfully defended his doctoral thesis in physics in 1962.{{rp|xi}}<ref name="Taylor & Francis, Saleem & Rafique, 2016">{{cite book |last1=Saleem |first1=Mohammad |last2=Rafique |first2=Muhammad |title=Group Theory for High Energy Physicists |date=2016 |publisher=Taylor & Francis |isbn=978-1-4665-1064-7 |pages=206 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ojvSBQAAQBAJ&q=Dr.+Muhammad+Saleem+physics |accessdate=27 April 2020 |language=en}}</ref>

He was the founding director of the [[Centre for High Energy Physics]] (CHEP), and served in the faculty of physics at the [[University of Florida]] in the United States.<ref name="Lahore World">{{cite news |author=Staff Reporter |title=Renowned Physicist Prof Dr Muhammad Saleem passes away |url=https://lahoreworld.com/2016/01/02/75902/ |accessdate=27 April 2020 |work=Lahore News, political scandals, scams, Entertainment, Sports, Lahore history, Lahore police and infotainment portal |date=2 January 2016}}</ref> He was the author of text of [[modern physics]], namely quantum mechanics, special relativity, and high-energy physics, written in collaboration with mathematician, Dr. Muhammad Rafique, which have been published internationally.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Saleem |first1=Mohammad |last2=Rafique |first2=Muhammad |title=Group Theory for High Energy Physicists |date=2016 |publisher=Taylor & Francis |isbn=978-1-4665-1064-7 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ojvSBQAAQBAJ |accessdate=27 April 2020 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Saleem |first1=Mohammad |title=Quantum Mechanics |date=2015 |publisher=IOP, Publishing Limited |isbn=978-0-7503-1207-3 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=lTg2jgEACAAJ |accessdate=27 April 2020 |language=en}}</ref>

On 2 January 2016, Saleem died in Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan, and is buried in Punjab University's graveyard.<ref name="The Nation, 2016" />
